## Core Testing Capabilities & Toolkit

### Test Automation & Frameworks
- Selenium WebDriver (Java) with Page Object Model (POM) design pattern
- Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) for end-to-end browser workflows
- TestNG test runner, suite configuration, and parallel test execution
- Cucumber BDD with Gherkin scenario syntax
- Appium for Android automated functional and regression test suites

### REST API Testing
- Postman collections, pre-request scripts, automated test assertions, and environment variables
- REST Assured for programmatic API contract validation
- JSON Schema verification and payload contract conformity
- HTTP status code edge-case validation (2xx, 4xx, 5xx)
- Payment webhook idempotency and token validation (OAuth 2.0 / JWT)

### Performance & Load Testing
- Apache JMeter for distributed load, stress, spike, and endurance simulations
- Concurrency simulation tested up to 100,000 concurrent virtual users
- Throughput bottlenecks, server response latency, and database pool saturation analysis

### Mobile & Cross-Browser Testing
- Android mobile application testing on physical devices and emulators
- Cross-browser compatibility across Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Microsoft Edge, and Apple Safari
- Viewport responsiveness, resolution fragmentation, and touch gesture verification

### DevOps & Methodologies
- CI/CD quality gates and automated pipeline execution with GitHub Actions
- Defect lifecycle management and sprint tracking in JIRA
- SQL database testing (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase) for transactional state assertions
- Agile/Scrum sprint ceremonies and release sign-offs

## Production Systems Tested & Case Studies

### 1. DRIWE — Cab & Courier Booking Platform (Web + Mobile)
- Industry: Transportation & Logistics
- Scope: Driver geospatial allocation, dynamic surge pricing calculations, coupon validations, Razorpay payment webhooks, and 100,000-user distributed load testing.
- Key Defect: Discovered a negative fare race condition where rapid promo code re-application during surge velocity produced negative booking totals (-₹45), mistakenly crediting rider wallets.
- Resolution: Introduced atomic checkout locking, server-side idempotency keys, and JMeter concurrency assertions.
- Outcome: 78 defects logged and tracked in JIRA (including 14 critical severity bugs pre-release); verified 99.9% uptime under 100,000 simulated concurrent users.

### 2. Grosido — Grocery Delivery Platform (Web Admin + Mobile Apps)
- Industry: E-Commerce / Grocery Delivery
- Scope: Multi-module grocery platform (Customer App, Admin Panel, Delivery App); real-time cart inventory reservation and checkout synchronization.
- Key Defect: Uncovered distributed cache desynchronization where active customer shopping carts retained stale promotional prices after admin flash sales expired.
- Resolution: Automated cache eviction hooks on price updates and Selenium POM price assertion suites.
- Outcome: ~40% reduction in regression cycle time through Selenium WebDriver + TestNG framework; safeguarded inventory accuracy across 8+ sprint releases.

### 3. E-Commerce Ecosystem (Web Seller/Admin + Mobile Apps)
- Industry: E-Commerce / Multi-Vendor Marketplace
- Scope: Complete order-to-delivery lifecycle across Customer, Seller, Admin, and Delivery modules; cross-browser checkout parity across 5 browser engines.
- Key Defect: Identified refund webhook retry double-deduction in seller commission settlement ledgers.
- Resolution: Built webhook idempotency intake validation and automated cross-browser payment regression suites.
- Outcome: 18 critical bugs resolved before production release; verified payment stability across 5 major browser combinations.

### 4. Ride Sharing Application (Android Mobile App)
- Industry: Mobility / Transportation
- Scope: Driver route publishing, real-time rider seat matching, route telemetry, and 22 RESTful CRUD API endpoints.
- Key Defect: Concurrent seat reservation race condition where near-simultaneous seat bookings within a 12ms window caused 5 passengers to be booked into a 4-passenger vehicle.
- Resolution: Enforced database pessimistic locking on seat inventory and concurrent Postman regression assertions.
- Outcome: 180+ test cases executed; 22 REST APIs validated with full JIRA tracking.

### 5. Urban Build — Lead Generation Platform (Android Mobile App)
- Industry: Construction & Real Estate
- Scope: Multi-category lead generation forms, SMS notifications, contractor filtering, and CRM integration endpoints.
- Key Defect: Rapid multi-tap duplicate lead submission firing repetitive SMS and CRM notifications on high-latency mobile networks.
- Resolution: Client-side debounce with disabled state and backend SHA-256 fingerprint idempotency verification.
- Outcome: 15+ API flows validated; 6+ complete test cycles executed.
